title: Best Character Animators (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a character animator for 2D or 3D animation: what to include, character design, rigging, rights, price factors and red flags.
intro: Character animators bring characters to life for explainer videos, ads, games, children's content and social media. The work includes designing characters, preparing them for movement and animating actions and expressions. Projects go wrong when characters are not approved before animation, voice and timing are not locked, or rights to the characters are unclear. This guide helps you plan a smooth character animation project.

faq.a: Rigging prepares a character for animation by adding a system of joints and controls. A well-rigged character can be reused for future animations.
2D suits many explainer and social videos and is often faster. 3D suits games, product scenes and certain styles. Choose based on your style and budget.
Yes, for dialogue. Animators time mouth movements and actions to the final audio, so changes to audio later can mean re-animating.
Agree in writing. If you want to reuse the character in future videos or merchandise, you need the rights and the source files.

faq.q: Can the animator design the character too?
faq.a: Many can. Approve the character design before animation starts.
